ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated against the pinned SHA-256.
All three printed page markers, both dated sections, all Max Müller references, all four French passages, numbered lists, and all three apparatus notes are represented.
раскольник / раскольники is rendered schismatic(s), retaining Tolstoy's historical term rather than silently replacing it with the more specific modern label Old Believer.
The fragment На весах — осуждать не любить или подождать судить — не смотреть remains deliberately fragmentary in English; no syntactic reconstruction is imposed.

The source places footnote marker [^2] after the French sentence about metempsychosis/immortality, while note [^2] actually translates the much earlier St. Augustine quotation. This semantically displaced apparatus is preserved at the source position rather than silently reassigned.
Нашу лучше оцен. is kept as the visibly incomplete Ours better eval... rather than conjecturally completing the notebook shorthand.
The French quotations remain visible as Tolstoy's language switches; only the Russian apparatus gloss that actually exists in the source is translated.
